name: contents-nav
title: Contents Nav
description: Page outline and catalogue index composed with List Item. Use toc for on-page headings with optional nest line and scroll spy. Use index for sectioned side navigation.

api.description: Page outline and catalogue index composed with List Item. Use variant toc for on-page headings with nested rows, optional nest guide line, and scroll spy. Use variant index for sectioned side navigation. Pass scrollRoot for the host scrollport. Compose with ContentsNavHeading, ContentsNavSection, ContentsNavItem, and ListItemNest, or pass items and sections.

groups.title: ContentsNav
groups.description: Root nav. toc defaults nestLine and scrollSpy on. index defaults them off and uses section labels.

props.name: variant
props.description: toc is the on-page outline. index is the catalogue or side index.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading above the list. Typical for toc (for example On this page).

props.name: items
props.description: Tree or flat rows. Each item needs id and title. Optional href, children, disabled, and readOnly. toc defaults href to #id when omitted. Pass href null for a non-link row. readOnly keeps size and selected chrome without hover or activation.

props.name: sections
props.description: Grouped index sections with label, optional divided, and items. Used when variant is index and layout is grouped.

props.name: layout
props.description: Index list shape. grouped renders sections. flat renders items only.

props.name: nestLine
props.description: Default guide line for nested groups. Defaults true for toc and false for index. Override per group with ListItemNest line.

props.name: scrollSpy
props.description: Update activeId from scroll position. Defaults true for toc and false for index.

props.name: scrollRoot
props.description: Scrollport used by scroll spy. Defaults to document.scrollingElement. Pass your app scroller when the page does not scroll on the document.

props.name: spyRatio
props.description: Fraction of the scrollport height used as the primary spy marker.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled active item id.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial active id.

props.name: onActiveIdChange
props.description: Called when the active id changes from spy or selection.

props.name: itemVariant
props.description: Default List Item variant for rows.

props.name: itemSize
props.description: Default List Item size for top-level rows. Defaults to "sm" for toc and "md" for index.

props.name: nestItemSize
props.description: Default List Item size for nested rows.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for every row (padding, gap, type size/family/weight/color, radius, fills, and stroke). Applies to composed ContentsNavItem rows and data-driven branches. Per-item chrome props on ContentsNavItem win. See List Item for the full chrome contract.

props.name: nestChrome
props.description: Default ListItemNest chrome for data-driven child groups (indent, pad, gap, lineWidth, lineColor). nestLine still controls whether the guide line paints. Composed ListItemNest instances set their own props.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Render a custom host for each data item (for example a router Link). The host is painted with List Item via asChild.

props.name: children
props.description: Composition mode. Use ContentsNavHeading, ContentsNavSection, ContentsNavItem, and ListItemNest instead of items or sections.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the nav host.

groups.title: ContentsNavHeading
groups.description: Title row above the list (data-df contents-nav-heading).

props.name: children
props.description: Heading text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: ContentsNavSection
groups.description: Index section with ListItemLabel nav and optional top divider.

props.name: label
props.description: Section title rendered with ListItemLabel variant nav.

props.name: divided
props.description: When true, adds a top hairline and spacing above the section.

props.name: children
props.description: Section rows.

groups.title: ContentsNavItem
groups.description: List Item row for a nav entry. Also accepts List Item chrome props such as padding, gap, fontSize, fills, stroke, and radius. Per-item chrome wins over ContentsNav itemChrome. See List Item.

props.name: active
props.description: Selected appearance. When omitted and itemId is set, matches activeId from context.

props.name: itemId
props.description: Id used for selection and scroll spy matching.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor row when asChild is false.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Paint List Item onto a single child element such as a link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-interactive row. Forwarded to List Item. Dims the row and blocks activation.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational row. Forwarded to List Item. Keeps size, variant, and selected appearance with no hover, press, or activation.

props.name: size
props.description: Overrides the size default. Outside ListItemNest, defaults to itemSize. Inside ListItemNest, defaults to nestItemSize.

props.name: variant
props.description: Overrides the ContentsNav itemVariant default.

groups.title: ContentsNavSeparator
groups.description: Horizontal hairline between flat index groups.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-contents-nav-gap
props.description: Gap between top-level children. Index defaults to 0 so sections own rhythm.

props.name: --df-contents-nav-branch-gap
props.description: Gap between a row and its nested group.

props.name: --df-contents-nav-heading-margin-bottom
props.description: Space under ContentsNavHeading.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-indent
props.description: Outer inset on ListItemNest. Set by the indent prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-pad
props.description: Inner pad after the nest guide line. Set by the pad prop.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-gap
props.description: Gap between nested rows. Set by the gap prop on ListItemNest.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-line-width
props.description: Nest guide line thickness. Set by lineWidth.

props.name: --df-list-item-nest-line-color
props.description: Nest guide line color. Set by lineColor.
